findings.summary: The dismiss path (戻る / Escape) is not tested in any browser suite, so a regression where 戻る still cancels, or the dialog cancels on close, would pass.
findings.evidence: UI-06 and LOCAL-UI-07 only exercise 取消を確定. grep for 戻る / dismissCancellation in scripts/*.mjs, scripts/*.cjs, tests/*/*.mjs finds no test usage. The dialog exists only to prevent accidental cancellation, so its 'do nothing' branch is the safety-relevant one. This gap predates this change (it arrived with the 2026-11-12 UI change), so it does not block this test-only repair.
findings.suggestedFix: In UI-06, tap キャンセル, tap 戻る, assert the dialog is hidden and data-cancelled is still null, then reopen and confirm. Do the same in LOCAL-UI-07 with ride status still 'scheduled'.

findings.summary: LOCAL-UI-07 does not check that other reservations stay scheduled. A regression that cancels every reservation (or a neighbour as well) would pass. UI-06 cannot detect a wrong-reservation cancel because the trace-ui fixture has only R1.
findings.evidence: waitState only checks ride.id is 'cancelled'; there is no assertion on the other rides in state(). harness.tsx defines rides:[R1] only. A wrong single reservation IS caught (waitState on ride.id would time out), and the dialog-text check at line 163 ties the dialog to the LOCAL-ONLY memo.
findings.suggestedFix: After confirming, assert that every ride in before.rides that was 'scheduled' is still 'scheduled'.

findings.summary: The global native-dialog auto-accept handlers (here and tests/reviewer-ui/run.mjs:19) no longer serve the cancel/complete flows but still silently accept any alert()/confirm(). This hides unexpected native dialogs (e.g. validation alert() in AddRideModal/AddTicketModal, or a stray confirm()).
findings.evidence: Cancellation itself is not masked: if ParentPortal regressed to window.confirm, the handler would accept it but the required in-page dialog would never appear, so confirmDialog.waitFor() fails (mutation A shows exactly this failure mode). Remaining native dialogs in src: GoogleSettings.tsx:21-22 confirm(), and alert() at AddRideModal.tsx:55, AddStudentModal.tsx:30, AddTicketModal.tsx:43. The handlers would accept these with no record.
findings.suggestedFix: Record native dialogs (type and message) into the report, and fail the current check when one is unexpected, instead of accepting silently. run_hosted_acceptance.cjs:338 already records them.

findings.summary: REVIEW-UI-02 regex /^送迎完了（\d回消費）/ is appropriately scoped.
findings.evidence: Accessible name is aria-label completionLabel(ride) = '送迎完了（N回消費） <student> <date> <time> <type>' (TeacherDashboard.tsx:111-115,469). Roundtrip gives '送迎完了（2回消費）', which matches. The pending label starts with '完了処理中', which does not match. The cancel button aria-label '... の予約を取消' (line 477) does not match. tr.filter({hasText:'CUST-04 完了用A・片道'}) matches exactly one row (the pickupLocation in the seed is unique), so the locator stays scoped to the intended reservation. \d does not check that N equals the expected consumption, but the balance waits (5->4->2) do. The re-check after reload (count===0) is still meaningful because a completed row renders no completion button.
findings.suggestedFix: Optional: use name:/^送迎完了（1回消費）/ for A and /^送迎完了（2回消費）/ for B to also pin the label to the ride type.

findings.summary: Claim about REVIEW-UI-03 is correct: it has no boot() and relies on REVIEW-UI-02's end state (balance 2 + 10 = 12).
findings.evidence: The seed balance is 5. When 02 fails before any completion (old exact '完了' locator finds nothing because aria-label overrides the name, or mutation C no-op), the balance stays 5. 03 then reaches 15 and waitForFunction(===12) times out, which matches mutation C results.json ('REVIEW-UI-03 ... page.waitForFunction: Timeout'). This coupling is pre-existing and makes 03 a false-negative amplifier of 02.
findings.suggestedFix: Optional: give REVIEW-UI-03 its own boot() and assert balance === start + 10.

findings.summary: UI-06 does check the real behaviour: the dialog must appear, nothing is cancelled before confirm, and confirm cancels R1. Skipping the dialog fails (mutation A), as does a no-op confirm (mutation B).
findings.evidence: harness onCancelRide sets data-cancelled synchronously, so the null assertion would catch an implementation that cancels on opening the dialog. There is no global dialog handler in this file, so Playwright auto-dismisses any native confirm; a regression to window.confirm would therefore fail as well.
